jobs.name: sandbox-approved-spec-task
jobs.prompt: Work only in the current Sandbox repository and follow AGENTS.md. Before doing anything, require a clean Git worktree; if it is dirty, report REVIEW_REQUIRED without changing files. Find the first unchecked implementation task in the active Spec-Kit feature referenced by .specify/feature.json. Implement at most that one bounded task in the existing isolated Hermes worktree, run its narrow required checks, and update only that task checkbox after the checks pass. Do not commit, push, deploy, remove worktrees, edit credentials, or perform external mutations. If there is no approved unchecked task, report NO_APPROVED_WORK without changing files.

jobs.name: lenzora-todo-task
jobs.prompt: Work only in the current Lenzora repository and follow AGENTS.md. Before doing anything, require a clean Git worktree; if it is dirty, report REVIEW_REQUIRED without changing files. Treat repository-root TODO.md as the only automatic work source. If TODO.md is missing or has no unchecked Markdown checklist item, report NO_TODO_WORK without changing files. Review unchecked '- [ ]' items in file order and select only the first actionable item. You may skip an item only when its text explicitly says it is blocked by an unmet prerequisite; do not edit skipped items. If every unchecked item is blocked, report REVIEW_REQUIRED with the blocking prerequisite and change nothing. Do not infer or begin a second actionable task. If the selected task requires Spec-Kit and the repository's legacy .Codex command files are absent, use the canonical Sandbox-provisioned .agents/skills/speckit-*/SKILL.md workflows and .specify templates/scripts in this isolated worktree, in the required sequence; do not hand-author artifacts. If the selected task requires credentials, production deployment, deletion, external communication, payments, or an architectural decision, report REVIEW_REQUIRED without changing files. Implement only that one bounded task in the existing isolated Hermes worktree, run its narrow required checks, and mark only its TODO checkbox complete after the checks pass. Do not commit, push, deploy, remove worktrees, edit credentials, or perform external mutations. Always finish with exactly one non-empty terminal result: COMPLETED_TODO_TASK followed by the selected task summary after a verified change; NO_TODO_WORK; or REVIEW_REQUIRED followed by the concrete blocker. Never return an empty or SILENT response.
